Antarctica.note: Antarctica is not a sovereign state and has no national capital.

Bolivia.note: Sucre is the constitutional capital; La Paz is the seat of government.

Eswatini.note: Mbabane is the administrative capital; Lobamba is the royal and legislative capital.

Nauru.note: Nauru has no official capital; Yaren District functions as the de facto capital.

South Africa.note: South Africa has three capitals: Pretoria (executive), Cape Town (legislative), and Bloemfontein (judicial).

Sri Lanka.note: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is the official legislative capital.
